chocobosreborn.almanac.overview.title: Overview
chocobosreborn.almanac.overview.body:
[h] Chocobos Reborn
Final Fantasy VII chocobos in Minecraft. Catch a wild Yellow, train it on greens, mate it with nuts, race at Whiskerwind and walk the farm line to Green, Blue, Black and Gold.

[birds]

[h] The loop
[step] Tame a wild Yellow with Gysahl Greens (one in three per feed).
[step] Saddle it and ride: sprint to dash, jump to hop.
[step] Feed the eight greens to train speed, stamina, intelligence and cooperation.
[step] Take the Pocketwatch to Whiskerwind, race for GP and first-place finishes.
[step] Buy Carob and Zeio nuts, breed the rarer colours, and race them higher.

Adults stand about 3.25 m to the crest. Chicobos hatch at a quarter of player height and grow through three stages. Females wear a shorter crest. My Chocobos lists every bird you own with its stats, race record, genes and family line.
chocobosreborn.almanac.taming.title: Taming
chocobosreborn.almanac.taming.body:
[h] Where wild birds live
Wild Yellows roam the Overworld. Each rolls a grade at spawn: Poor, Average, Good, Great or Wonderful. On ordinary ground Great is the best you will find; only birds that spawn on snow or ice can be Wonderful, about one in eight there.
Nether Chocobos live in the Nether; End Chocobos on the End's outer islands. They tame the same way.

[h] How to tame
[item:chocobosreborn:gysahl_green] Hold a Gysahl Green and right-click the bird. Each feed has a one in three chance to tame it. A tame bird sits when told, follows you, and says kweh; wild or hurt birds wark.
[item:chocobosreborn:chocobo_lure] A Chocobo Lure in hand draws wild birds toward you and outlines them within 32 blocks: the easy way to spot the cold-pad Wonderfuls.

[h] Grades
Grade sets base speed and stamina and gates the farm line: Green and Blue need Good parents, Gold needs a Wonderful Yellow. Training lifts the grade one step per 120 points, so a Good wild bird can be raised to Wonderful.
chocobosreborn.almanac.greens.title: Greens & Training
chocobosreborn.almanac.greens.body:
[h] Feeding
Right-click an owned bird with a green. It eats one, heals a little, regains 20 stamina and gains training points; a chick fed greens grows faster. You get a line with its four totals and the feeds of that green it will still take. A bird takes one training green every 5 minutes, so you cannot stack a Poor bird in one sitting and beat Class C. Wild Gysahl tames do not count as training.

[h] The eight greens
[item:chocobosreborn:gysahl_green] Gysahl: speed 2, stamina 2, cooperation 2 (40 feeds). Grows from seeds dropped by grass. Also tames and heals.
[item:chocobosreborn:krakka_green] Krakka: intelligence 6 (40). Craftable.
[item:chocobosreborn:tantal_green] Tantal: speed 2, stamina 4 (40). Craftable.
[item:chocobosreborn:pahsana_green] Pahsana: intelligence 4, cooperation 4 (30).
[item:chocobosreborn:curiel_green] Curiel: speed 4, stamina 4 (30).
[item:chocobosreborn:mimett_green] Mimett: speed 4, stamina 4, cooperation 2 (24).
[item:chocobosreborn:reagan_green] Reagan: 4 of everything (16).
[item:chocobosreborn:sylkis_green] Sylkis: speed 8, stamina 8, intelligence 6, cooperation 6 (12).

[h] What the points do
Each stat caps at 100. Speed raises mounted speed up to 35%, stamina enlarges the dash pool, intelligence makes dashes cheaper, cooperation is handling: how tightly the bird follows your hands, and how tightly a field racer holds its line. The field uses the same four stats. Every 120 total points lifts the grade one step.
A sated or still-digesting bird learns nothing from a green, but a hurt one still eats it and heals; at full health it refuses. A sated bird regains one feed of each kind per day. Every other green comes from Sage Wynn at Whiskerwind or race prizes; only Gysahl grows in the wild.

[h] Feathers
Your adult birds shed a feather every 5 to 10 minutes. Brush one (a vanilla brush, 16 durability a stroke) and a feather comes loose on the spot.
chocobosreborn.almanac.nuts.title: Nuts & Breeding
chocobosreborn.almanac.nuts.body:
[h] Mating
[step] Feed a nut to each of two owned adults of opposite sex.
[step] They fall in love and mate; the stronger nut decides the chick.
[step] Plain nuts keep a parent's colour; Carob and Zeio move the farm line.

[item:chocobosreborn:pepio_nut] Pepio, Luchile, Saraha, Lasan, Pram, Porov: plain nuts. The nut's tier (1 to 6) sets the chick's talent, four training points per tier plus a share of the parents' training.
[item:chocobosreborn:carob_nut] Carob: Bilo at Whiskerwind, or a win prize: 15% at Class B, 40% at Class A, always at Class S. Good Yellows to Green or Blue; Green with Blue to Black (White on a miss).
[item:chocobosreborn:zeio_nut] Zeio: Bilo at 128 GP or a rare S-class prize. Black with a Wonderful Yellow to Gold. Gold never hatches without it.

[h] The farm line
[diagram:breeding]

[h] Race wins are required
As in FF7, colour breeding needs racers. Both parents must have first-place finishes at Whiskerwind before Carob or Zeio can change the line: 1 each for Green or Blue, 2 each for Black, 3 each for Gold. From there the chance climbs from 25% to certain at 4, 9 and 12 combined wins. A bird short of wins tells you so when you hand it the nut. A Gold parent without Zeio passes on Yellow.
The chick's born grade is the integer average of the parents' born grades, one step higher with Zeio. Greens that lifted a parent's shown grade are not averaged in; the chick only inherits nut-tier talent plus a share of the parents' training. End and Nether chocobos breed true; no nut turns them into a farm-line colour.
chocobosreborn.almanac.colors.title: Colours & Abilities
chocobosreborn.almanac.colors.body:
[birds]

[h] Yellow
The wild pad-runner. Land 20, water 10, 30 health. Crosses nothing special.
[h] Green
Mountain bird. Land 27, water 10, 30 health. Climbs walls, cliffs and the ridges on the race courses.
[h] Blue
River bird. Land 27, water 50, 30 health. Walks on shallow water (up to three deep) and gives its rider water breathing.
[h] White
A missed Black roll. Land 35, water 45, 40 health. Climbs and crosses shallow water.
[h] Black
Land 40, water 20, 40 health. Climbs, crosses shallow water, and its rider sees at night.
[h] Gold
Land 50, water 45, 50 health. Does everything: climbs, crosses any water including the ocean, shrugs off fire, heals slowly on its own, gives its rider water breathing and night vision, and flies off the course (not during a heat). Hold jump to flap, look up while moving to climb, hold the sprint key to dive.
[h] End Chocobo
The purple bird of the End's outer islands, end stone in its feathers. Land 45, water 40, 50 health. Climbs, crosses any water, gives its rider water breathing, and its rider drifts down instead of falling.
[h] Nether Chocobo
The red bird of the Nether, lava in its feathers. Land 40, water 10, 50 health. Fire immune, walks on lava, gives its rider fire resistance.
chocobosreborn.almanac.riding.title: Riding
chocobosreborn.almanac.riding.body:
[h] Saddle up
[item:chocobosreborn:chocobo_saddle] Craft a Chocobo Saddle and right-click an owned adult with it. Right-click again to ride.
[step] Sprint to dash on stamina; ease off to recover. A bird with no stamina left slows to a trot.
[step] Cooperation is handling: a raw bird turns late and strafes poorly; a trained one goes where you look. Field racers feel the same four stats.
[step] Jump hops; on a Gold it flaps.
[step] Sneak is down on the water: a river bird ducks under. In the air a Gold dives on the sprint key, as fast as it climbs.
[step] You can only sneak-dismount on solid ground, so you never fall off mid-air.

[h] Using things from the saddle
Your crosshair passes through the bird while you drive it, so doors, blocks and mobs work. Sneak to target the bird itself: feed it, or open its equipment.

[h] Equipment
Sneak-click your bird with an empty hand (or press your inventory key while riding) to open its saddle, armor and saddlebag slots.
[item:chocobosreborn:iron_chocobo_armor] Chocobo armor comes in leather, iron, diamond and netherite and protects the bird. An armored bird cannot race.
[item:chocobosreborn:saddlebags] Saddlebags add fifteen slots. Name them on an anvil and the name heads the bird's inventory.
[item:chocobosreborn:chocobo_pocketwatch] The Chocobo Pocketwatch winds you to Whiskerwind and back. On a saddled bird of yours, the bird comes with you; your other birds nearby follow too.
chocobosreborn.almanac.square.title: Whiskerwind Square
chocobosreborn.almanac.square.body:
[h] Whiskerwind
A village on a sky island in the void, with a course for every taste floating around it. Reach it with a Chocobo Pocketwatch, or through the Farmhand at any Chocobo Farm. On foot, sneak-click Esther to go home.

[h] Ranked heats
[step] Heats go off every five minutes, one per class. Ride a saddled bird to Esther on the overlook to enter the next one (your class or any class below); she calls it at two minutes, one minute and counts the last ten seconds. Be in the saddle when it goes.
[step] The first rider in picks the course: three sprints (one lap, a minute or more) or three grands prix (three laps of two minutes or more, longer up the classes). Every course is a proper circuit: straights, sweepers, hairpins, chicanes and hills, each on its own themed sky island with a grandstand in the infield.
[step] Riders of that class or higher who see Esther join the same heat, each taking an AI racer's stall. The rest of the six stalls are named regulars drawn from that class's roster; a few also race one class up. From Class B on, Jolo (a Gold) and Teiyo (a Black) take two stalls, and they drive like champions.
[step] Three first-place finishes promote; a bird never drops a class. Prizes are paid in GP and greens or nuts, only for a finished course. Racing below your class pays half the purse and does not count toward promotion.
[step] Flanking the avenue just this side of the arch are the practice gates: the west sprint (one lap) and the east grand prix (three laps). Ride or click for a fun heat that does not count toward promotion.
[step] Each course has a chequered line and a painted grid under the gantry; follow the yellow arrow. Coloured posts stand just before water, lava, ridges and bogs.

[h] Boosts and terrain
Every course has boost strips across the road: run over the chevrons for a burst of speed. From Class B the circuits carry features across the direct line with a slower road around: water (river birds walk it, everyone else swims), ridges (climbers go over, everyone else goes round) and, on the Nether and Keep courses, lava (only the Nether bird and Gold cross it). Class A adds bogs of mud that slow everyone, so the detour is the smart route, and A and S stack more features with taller ridges. Pick the bird for the course. Armored birds cannot race. Nothing in Whiskerwind can hurt you or your bird, so a wrong line costs a place, not a life.

[h] The village
[item:chocobosreborn:gp] Rook the Bookie takes one bet per heat. See him before Esther starts it: empty hand cycles your pick, then hand him 1 to 16 GP. A rider in the heat can only back themselves. Scratch or miss refunds a pending stake; a DNF after the start does not.
Sable the duel master runs two-rider races outside the ladder: post a challenge with a course and an optional GP side bet, and the next rider who accepts races you for the pot.
Pell the broker swaps birds between two players, or hands a gifted bird to a player on foot.
Stalls, all priced in GP: Sage Wynn (greens), Bilo the Nutkeeper (nuts, Zeio at 128), Tack (saddles, lures), the Fair (this almanac, pocketwatches, fireworks, leads), and Marl's GP Exchange for everyday goods. A gysahl bed sits beside Sage Wynn's stall.
chocobosreborn.almanac.farm.title: Chocobo Farm
chocobosreborn.almanac.farm.body:
[h] Chocobo Farms
Farms dot the plains, meadows, savannas and cherry groves: a barn, a paddock with a couple of wild Yellows, a gysahl patch, a Stablehand in the barn who sells Gysahl and seeds, and a Farmhand at the gate.

[h] The Farmhand
Talk to the Farmhand and you are sent to Whiskerwind, on foot or in the saddle. Your birds nearby come along.

Find a farm with /locate structure chocobosreborn:chocobo_farm.
chocobosreborn.almanac.items.title: Items
chocobosreborn.almanac.items.body:
[item:chocobosreborn:gysahl_green_seeds] Gysahl Green Seeds: from grass. Plant and harvest like wheat.
[item:chocobosreborn:chocobo_lure] Chocobo Lure: amethyst around a gysahl. Draws and outlines wild birds.
[item:chocobosreborn:chocobo_saddle] Chocobo Saddle: leather and iron. Ride.
[item:chocobosreborn:chocobo_almanac] Chocobo Almanac: a book and a gysahl. This.
[item:chocobosreborn:chocobo_pocketwatch] Chocobo Pocketwatch: gold nuggets around a clock with a gysahl. Whiskerwind and back.
[item:chocobosreborn:gp] GP: Whiskerwind money, won on the course, spent at the stalls.
[item:chocobosreborn:carob_nut] Carob and Zeio Nuts: Bilo the Nutkeeper at Whiskerwind, or race prizes: Carob on a Class B win (15%), Class A win (40%) or any Class S race; Zeio rarely on a Class S win.
[item:chocobosreborn:diamond_chocobo_armor] Chocobo Armor: seven leather, ingots or diamonds in an H (netherite: diamond armor + ingot). Bird protection, no racing.
[item:chocobosreborn:saddlebags] Saddlebags: eight leather round a chest. Fifteen slots on the bird.
[item:chocobosreborn:gold_chocobo_spawn_egg] Spawn eggs for all eight colours and for the kin.
